subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR require live Telegram owner-session proof before merge, or may maintainers accept source-level regression coverage for this delivery path?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible and the patch is narrow, but the affected behavior is user-visible Telegram topic/session delivery and the PR body explicitly says live proof is still pending.

options.title: Require live owner-session proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally merge with source and regression-test evidence only, while owning the remaining real-transport delivery risk.

options.title: Pause for broader delivery design
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want one canonical delivery contract across background-task, ACP, subagent, and pending-handoff wake paths.

recommendation.title: Require live owner-session proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main blame and repeated heartbeat/subagent routing work make this the best available owner for the proof-sufficiency decision.
